title: Catalogue the Depths
description: One aberration and one coffer are samples. Complete Fathoms' own fish catalogue milestone so the Historian's investigation rests on the whole implemented catch set rather than a single curiosity.
description_completed: The catalogue is complete. The Historian has one final procedure left to place before you.

dialogue.offer: A single specimen is a story. A complete catalogue is evidence. Finish the Fathoms catch record and come back.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: That is the complete catalogue. There is only one field test left in this line of inquiry.
dialogue.completed: The catches are recorded. What remains is not fishing.

prerequisites.name: Open a coffer from the depths

objectives.name: Catch every fish required by the Fathoms catalogue
